ammo.title: R7 Ammo System
ammo.reloadTooltip: Left-click: reload a magazine. Right-click: unload the magazine.
ammo.internalReloadTooltip: Left-click: fill the internal magazine from loose rounds. Right-click: eject all rounds.

reloadDialog.title: Empty Magazine
reloadDialog.content: The current magazine is empty. Would you like to reload?
reloadDialog.internalContent: The internal magazine is empty. Would you like to reload from loose ammunition?

notices.cleanupFailed: R7 Ammo: the transfer succeeded, but an empty ammunition stack could not be deleted. Its quantity remains zero.

errors.invalidCount: Enter a non-negative whole round count, or a positive count for transfers.
errors.invalidType: Type IDs must use lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens (1–64 characters).
errors.permission: You must own this actor or item to use R7 Ammo.
errors.blocked: R7 Ammo is blocked for this actor after a failed recovery. Ask the GM to audit its ammunition before clearing the ammoBlocked flag.
errors.missingItem: The requested inventory item no longer exists.
errors.writeFailed: The ammunition transfer failed and its previous counts were restored. No automatic retry was made.
errors.ejectFirst: Eject the magazine before changing configuration, copying, transferring or deleting this item.
errors.unloadFirst: Eject all rounds before reconfiguring this.
errors.rangedOnly: R7 Ammo is supported only on ranged weapons.
errors.emptyNativeFirst: Empty this weapon's native ammunition counter before enabling R7 Ammo. Native ammunition is not converted into inventory items.
errors.invalidRole: Choose Magazine or Loose rounds for this item.
errors.singleMagazine: Each magazine must be a separate inventory item with quantity 1.
errors.invalidMagazine: This magazine has an invalid quantity, capacity or round count.
errors.brokenLink: The weapon and magazine data do not agree. Stop using the weapon and ask the GM to inspect the linked items.
errors.incompatibleRounds: These rounds do not match the magazine's cartridge type.
errors.notEnoughSpaceOrRounds: There are not enough loose rounds or enough free space in the magazine.
errors.notEnoughRounds: There are not enough rounds in the magazine.
errors.missingTemplate: The magazine has no ammunition metadata for recovering its rounds.
errors.incompatibleMagazine: This magazine does not match the weapon's magazine type.
errors.alreadyInserted: This magazine is already inserted in a weapon.
errors.notManaged: This weapon has not opted into R7 Ammo.
errors.noInsertedMagazine: Insert a compatible magazine before firing.
errors.managedCounter: Use the R7 Ammo controls for managed items. Native refill, direct counter edits and direct R7 flag edits are disabled.
errors.unsupportedSystem: This CoC7 version does not expose the expected weapon ammo methods. R7 Ammo could not be started.
errors.unsupportedAttack: This CoC7 version does not expose Actor.runRoll. Streamlined attacks are unavailable.
errors.missingWeaponSkill: Assign a valid primary skill to this weapon before attacking.
errors.attackInProgress: This weapon is already making an attack. Wait for it to finish.
errors.attackResultFailed: The attack failed after ammunition was spent. Check the chat and ammunition counts before retrying; spent rounds were not refunded.
errors.disregardAmmo: Disable CoC7's Disregard Ammo count setting before firing R7-managed weapons.
errors.noGM: A connected GM is required for R7 Ammo operations.
errors.inventoryOnly: Put this item in an actor's inventory before loading, unloading or using it.
errors.timeout: The GM did not acknowledge the operation. Check the current counts before trying again; it may already have completed.
errors.disconnected: The R7 Ammo connection closed. Check the current counts before retrying.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected R7 Ammo error occurred. Check the console and current ammunition counts before retrying.
